issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'חַשּׁוּב בֶּן פַּחַת מוֹאָב' (Hashub son of Pahath-Moab), but the Chinese renders '摩押的帕他特的兒子哈書巴' which reverses the order: it says 'Pahath of Moab's son Hashub' instead of 'Hashub son of Pahath-Moab'. The name 'Pahath-Moab' is a single proper name (פַּחַת מוֹאָב), not 'Pahath of Moab', and the Chinese splits it and reverses the father-son relationship, making it appear that Hashub is the son of 'Pahath of Moab' rather than the son of Pahath-Moab. This is a name/relationship error.
